question: Estimate the customer service tickets per day for Amazon India during festive sale (Great Indian Festival).
idealClarificationQuestions: Daily tickets across phone, chat, email, in-app? Yes — total.
During festive sale period (Sept-Oct, peak ~10 days)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily order volume × support contact rate × festive uplift.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Amazon India peak festive daily orders: ~10-12M (vs ~3-4M normal day).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Customer support contact rate during festive (returns, delays, defective issues spike): ~5-7% of orders = ~600K-800K tickets.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus pre-purchase queries (offer questions, EMI, delivery dates): ~10% of unique buyers ~5M shoppers/day = ~500K queries.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Amazon India peak festive daily orders
Plus pre-purchase queries (offer questions, EMI, delivery dates)

calculationFlow: Customer support contact rate during festive (returns, delays, defective issues spike): ~5-7% of orders = ~600K-800K tickets.
Plus pre-purchase queries (offer questions, EMI, delivery dates): ~10% of unique buyers ~5M shoppers/day = ~500K queries.
